# Threads connector

Go connector for the Meta Threads API: publishing text/image/video/ carousel posts, reading threads, managing replies, and fetching insights for a Threads professional account. Generated from a curated OpenAPI spec authored from the official Meta documentation (Meta publishes no OpenAPI spec).

## How to use this connector

One `Client` serves one Threads account, authenticated by a Threads
long-lived access token (its own OAuth system — NOT a Facebook/Instagram
token; scopes: `threads_basic`, `threads_content_publish`, plus
`threads_manage_replies` / `threads_read_replies` /
`threads_manage_insights` as needed):

```go
import (
    "github.com/pax-beehive/connector"
    "github.com/pax-beehive/connector/threads"
)

c, err := threads.NewClient(&threads.Config{AccessToken: "TH..."})
```

## Publishing (two steps)

```go
// 1. Create a container (TEXT shown; IMAGE/VIDEO take ImageUrl/VideoUrl,
//    CAROUSEL takes child container IDs in Children).
cont, err := c.CreateThreadsContainer(ctx, &threads.CreateThreadsContainerRequest{
    ThreadsUserId: userID,
    MediaType:     connector.Ptr("TEXT"),
    Text:          connector.Ptr("Hello Threads"),
})

// 2. Publish. For videos, poll GetContainerStatus until FINISHED first.
pub, err := c.PublishThread(ctx, &threads.PublishThreadRequest{
    ThreadsUserId: userID,
    CreationId:    cont.Id,
})
```

Replies and quotes are containers too: set `ReplyToId` or `QuotePostId`.
Control who can reply with `ReplyControl`. Quotas (250 posts + 1000
replies per 24h): check `GetPublishingLimit`.

## Auth model

- Every request sends `Authorization: Bearer <AccessToken>`.
- Long-lived tokens last 60 days. The connector does NOT auto-refresh:
  call `RefreshAccessToken` (token must be >24h old) on a schedule and
  persist the NEW token it returns. `ExchangeAccessToken` turns a
  short-lived OAuth token into a long-lived one.

## Errors

Non-2xx responses become `*connector.APIError`; `Code` is the Graph-style
error `code` (plus `/subcode`), `Message` is Meta's message. 190 =
invalid/expired token.

## Data conventions

- GET endpoints return only the fields you list in `Fields`.
- Text posts are limited to 500 characters; media URLs must be publicly
  reachable (Meta downloads them server-side).
- Pagination: pass `After`/`Before` cursors from `Paging.Cursors`.

## Capability boundaries (what this connector does NOT do)

- No OAuth consent flow: obtaining the initial token happens outside
  this SDK (ExchangeAccessToken/RefreshAccessToken only maintain it).
- No media file uploads: publishing works from public URLs only.
- No DMs, keyword search, mentions webhooks, or repost/delete of posts
  (not exposed by the public API at spec-authoring time).
- No retries by default; opt in with `connector.WithRetry`.

### Client options (all connectors)

`NewClient(cfg, opts...)` accepts shared options from the root
`connector` package:

- `connector.WithTimeout(d)` — overall per-call deadline (covers retries).
- `connector.WithRetry(connector.RetryPolicy{})` — opt-in automatic
  retries with exponential backoff honoring `Retry-After`. Defaults:
  3 attempts, statuses 429/502/503/504; non-idempotent methods (POST) are
  retried only on 429 unless `RetryNonIdempotent` is set.
- `connector.WithHTTPClient(hc)` — custom `*http.Client`.

### Error handling (all connectors)

Every non-2xx response is a `*connector.APIError` (StatusCode, service
Code/Message, raw Body, and the server's `RetryAfter` hint). Classify
without unwrapping via `connector.IsRateLimited(err)` (429),
`IsUnauthorized` (401), `IsForbidden` (403), `IsNotFound` (404),
`IsServerError` (5xx), `IsRetryable` (429/502/503/504), or use
`connector.AsAPIError(err)` / `connector.StatusCode(err)`.

Anything not listed here is outside this connector's capability boundary.
